title: Privacy Policy

body: Southwest Bowls Division (“SWD”, “we”, “our”, “us”) is committed to protecting the privacy of members, participants, volunteers, and website visitors.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
body: We may collect personal information including, but not limited to:

items: Information submitted through forms on this website

body: We only collect personal information that is reasonably necessary for the administration of lawn bowls activities, competitions, communications, and governance.

sections.heading: How We Use Information
body: Personal information may be used to:

items: Communicate important information related to bowls activities

sections.heading: Disclosure of Information
body: We do not sell, rent, or trade personal information.
Information may be shared only when necessary with:

items: Bowls USA or other governing bodies
Service providers assisting with administration or technology
Legal or regulatory authorities where required by law

sections.heading: Data Security
body: We take reasonable steps to protect personal information from misuse, loss, unauthorized access, or disclosure.

sections.heading: Access and Correction
body: Individuals may request access to or correction of their personal information by contacting us.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: This website may use cookies or similar technologies to improve functionality and user experience.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
body: This policy may be updated from time to time. Updates will be posted on this page.
